scanNote: 10-mashqdagi matn Cherchillni 1965-yilda vafot etganda '91 years old' deydi. Aslida u 1874-yil 30-noyabrda tug'ilgan va 1965-yil 24-yanvarda vafot etgan — ya'ni 90 yoshda edi. Bu kitobning kichik faktik xatosi; mashq javoblariga ta'sir qilmaydi. 11-mashqda aktrisaning eri 'Gary Marrill' deb yozilgan — haqiqiy yozilishi 'Gary Merrill'.

exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI DIALOG, HAR BIRIDA IKKI TANLOV
(jami 14 ta).

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  A: MORE beautiful than
     B: isn't as CLEVER as

  2  A: the MOST LUXURIOUS hotel of all
     B: on the NOISIEST street in Rome

  3  A: Was Claire SCARED ...?
     B: she screamed DESPERATELY

  4  A: much BIGGER than
     B: the MOST expensive of all

  5  A: prettier THAN that one
     B: the cheapest OF all

  6  A: CHEAPER than the blue shoes
     B: Are they AS comfortable as ...?

  7  A: Did the footballers play WELL?
     B: They played very BADLY.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  A: Krisning fikricha, Jenni Meridan
        go'zalroq.
     B: Ha, lekin u Meri chalik aqlli emas.
  2  A: Bu hammasidan hashamatli mehmonxona.
     B: Lekin u Rimdagi eng shovqinli ko'chada.
  3  A: Kler sherlarni ko'rganda qo'rqib ketdimi?
     B: Ha, va u jon-jahdi bilan qichqirdi.
  4  A: Semning mototsikli Tom yoki Franknikidan
        ancha kattaroq.
     B: U shuningdek hammasidan qimmat.
  5  A: Bu ko'ylak ana unisidan chiroyliroq.
     B: Ha, va u hammasidan arzon ham.
  6  A: Qora tuflilar ko'k tuflilardan arzonroq.
     B: Ular ko'klari chalik qulaymi?
  7  A: Futbolchilar kecha yaxshi o'ynadimi?
     B: Yo'q, o'ynashmadi. Ular juda yomon
        o'ynashdi.


QOIDALAR — TO'RT GURUH:

  A) DARAJA TANLASh (1A, 2A, 2B, 4A, 4B, 6A)
     'THAN' bor        →  QIYOSIY
     'the ... of/in'   →  ORTTIRMA
     'much'            →  QIYOSIY

  B) 'AS ... AS' — ODDIY ShAKL (1B, 6B)
     'isn't as CLEVER as'  ('cleverer' XATO)
     'as COMFORTABLE as'   ('much' XATO)

  C) BOG'LOVChI TANLASh (5A, 5B)
     QIYOSIY   →  THAN
     ORTTIRMA  →  OF / IN

  D) SIFAT ↔ RAVISh (3A, 3B, 7A, 7B)
     'be' fe'lidan keyin  →  SIFAT (scared)
     boshqa fe'ldan keyin →  RAVISH (desperately,
                              well, badly)


ENG ALDAMChI BANDLAR:

  1B: 'isn't as CLEVERER as' XATO.
      'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl.

  3A: 'Was Claire SCARY or SCARED?'
      'scary'  = qo'rqinchli (NARSA haqida)
      'scared' = qo'rqib ketgan (ODAM haqida)
      Kler — ODAM → SCARED.
      'a scary film' ✓ / 'a scared film' ✗

  6B: 'Are they AS comfortable AS ...?'
      Gapda ikkinchi 'as' bor → birinchi ham 'as'.
      'much comfortable as' XATO —
      'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

  7A/7B: 'play WELL' / 'played BADLY'
      'play' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
      good → WELL (noto'g'ri ravish)
      bad  → BADLY
      'play good' va 'played bad' XATO.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA IKKI DARAJA YONMA-YON:
  A: 'much BIGGER than'    → QIYOSIY (ikki narsa)
  B: 'the MOST expensive of all' → ORTTIRMA
     (hammasidan)
  Bir dialogda ikkala daraja ham.

items.textEn: 1  A: Chris thinks Jenny is ............ beautiful than Mary.
items.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'beautiful' — 3 bo'g'in → MORE.
'most' orttirma daraja uchun.

items.textEn: 1  B: She is, but she isn't as ............ as Mary.
items.uz: Ha, lekin u Meri chalik aqlli emas.
items.whyUz:
'AS ... AS' qolipi → ODDIY shakl.
'isn't as CLEVER as' ✓
'isn't as cleverer as' ✗

items.textEn: 2  A: This is the ............ hotel of all.
items.whyUz:
'THE ... OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'luxurious' — 4 bo'g'in → THE MOST LUXURIOUS.

items.textEn: 2  B: But it's on the ............ street in Rome.
items.uz: Lekin u Rimdagi eng shovqinli ko'chada.
items.whyUz:
'THE ... IN Rome' → ORTTIRMA daraja.
'noisy' — '-y' tushadi → THE NOISIEST.
'noisier' qiyosiy daraja uchun ('than' kerak
bo'lardi).

items.textEn: 3  A: Was Claire ............ when she saw the lions?
items.whyUz:
'scary'  = qo'rqinchli (NARSA haqida)
'scared' = qo'rqib ketgan (ODAM haqida)
Kler — ODAM → SCARED.
'a scary film' ✓ / 'a scared film' ✗

items.uz: Ha, va u jon-jahdi bilan qichqirdi.
items.whyUz:
'screamed' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
desperate (sifat) → DESPERATELY (ravish).
90-betdagi 4-mashqda ham shu juftlik bor edi.

items.textEn: 4  A: Sam's motorbike is much ............ than Tom's or Frank's.
items.uz: Semning mototsikli Tom yoki Franknikidan ancha kattaroq.
items.whyUz:
'MUCH' va 'THAN' — ikkalasi ham QIYOSIY
darajani talab qiladi.
'big' → BIGGER (undosh IKKILANADI).
'much biggest' XATO.

items.textEn: 4  B: It's also the ............ expensive of all.
items.whyUz:
'THE ... OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA daraja → MOST.
'the more expensive' XATO.
DIQQAT: bir dialogda A da QIYOSIY, B da
ORTTIRMA daraja.

items.textEn: 5  A: This dress is prettier ............ that one.
items.whyUz:
'prettIER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
'as' faqat 'as ... as' qolipida.
'that one' = 'that dress' o'rniga.

items.textEn: 5  B: Yes, and it is also the cheapest ............ all.
items.uz: Ha, va u hammasidan arzon ham.
items.whyUz:
'the cheapEST' ORTTIRMA + 'ALL' GURUH → OF.
'of all' = hammasidan.
'IN' esa JOY bilan ishlatiladi
('the cheapest IN town').

items.textEn: 6  A: The black shoes are ............ than the blue shoes.
items.whyUz:
'THAN' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
'cheap' → CHEAPER.
'cheapest than' XATO.

items.textEn: 6  B: Are they ............ comfortable as the blue ones?
items.whyUz:
Gapda IKKINCHI 'as' allaqachon bor →
birinchi ham 'AS': 'AS comfortable AS'.
'much comfortable' XATO — 'much' faqat
QIYOSIY daraja bilan ('much MORE comfortable').

items.textEn: 7  A: Did the footballers play ............ yesterday?
items.whyUz:
'play' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
good (sifat) → WELL (ravish, NOTO'G'RI shakl).
'play good' XATO.
90-betdagi 4-mashqning 8-bandi ham shu.

items.textEn: 7  B: No, they didn't. They played very ............ .
items.uz: Yo'q, o'ynashmadi. Ular juda yomon o'ynashdi.
items.whyUz:
'played' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
bad (sifat) → BADLY (ravish).
'played bad' XATO.
'well' ning aksi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the numbers to the letters to make sentences. (6 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplar hosil qilish uchun raqamlarni harflarga moslang. (6 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI GAP BOShI va OLTI DAVOMI.
Har birida BOG'LOVChI bor — u kalitni beradi.

Kitob BIRINChISINI chizib bergan: 1 → b


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1 → b   because  (SABAB)
  2 → d   and      (QO'SHISH)
  3 → f   when     (VAQT)
  4 → a   but      (QARAMA-QARSHILIK)
  5 → e   then     (KETMA-KETLIK)
  6 → c   so       (NATIJA)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

  1  The children couldn't go to the concert
     BECAUSE they didn't have any money.

  2  Paul married Elizabeth AND they had four
     children.

  3  We were in the fishing boat WHEN it started
     to rain.

  4  I wanted to make a cake, BUT I didn't have
     any sugar or flour.

  5  First, they got into the canoe, THEN they
     started paddling down the river.

  6  Roberta didn't like any of the souvenirs,
     SO she didn't buy any.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Bolalar konsertga bora olmadilar, chunki
     ularda pul yo'q edi.
  2  Pol Elizabetga uylandi va ularning to'rtta
     farzandi bo'ldi.
  3  Yomg'ir yog'a boshlaganda biz baliqchi
     qayig'ida edik.
  4  Men tort pishirmoqchi edim, lekin menda
     shakar ham, un ham yo'q edi.
  5  Avval ular kanoega chiqishdi, keyin daryo
     bo'ylab eshkak eshishni boshlashdi.
  6  Robertaga esdalik sovg'alarning hech biri
     yoqmadi, shuning uchun u hech narsa sotib
     olmadi.


BOG'LOVChILAR JADVALI (Unit 11, Workbook 45-bet):

  BECAUSE →  SABAB
     Nega bora olmadilar? — pul yo'q edi.

  AND     →  QO'SHISH
     Uylandi + farzandlari bo'ldi (bir yo'nalish).

  WHEN    →  VAQT
     Qachon? — yomg'ir boshlaganda.

  BUT     →  QARAMA-QARSHILIK
     Xohladi ↔ lekin masalliq yo'q edi.

  THEN    →  KETMA-KETLIK
     'FIRST ... THEN ...' — juftlik.

  SO      →  NATIJA
     Yoqmadi → shuning uchun sotib olmadi.


QO'ShIMChA IPLAR — MANTIQ:

  5-BAND ENG OSON:
     'FIRST, they got into the canoe' —
     'first' so'zi 'THEN' ni talab qiladi.
     'First ... then ...' — turg'un juftlik.

  2-BAND:
     'Paul MARRIED Elizabeth' + 'they had four
      CHILDREN' — oila mavzusi, bir yo'nalish → AND.

  3-BAND:
     'We WERE in the boat' + 'it STARTED to rain' —
     ikki voqea BIR VAQTDA → WHEN.


DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKOR GAPLARDA:
  1b: 'they DIDN'T have ANY money'
  4a: 'I DIDN'T have ANY sugar or flour'
  6:  'Roberta DIDN'T like ANY of the souvenirs'
  6c: 'she DIDN'T buy ANY'
  Hammasi INKOR gap → 'any' ('some' emas).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  flour        = un ('flower' — gul; bir xil
                 o'qiladi, boshqa ma'no!)
  a canoe      = kanoe
  to paddle    = eshkak eshmoq
  a fishing boat = baliqchi qayig'i
  a souvenir   = esdalik sovg'a

pairs.left: 1  The children couldn't go to the concert
pairs.right: b  because they didn't have any money.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA ChIZILGAN.
BECAUSE — SABAB.
Nega bora olmadilar? — pul yo'q edi.
DIQQAT: 'DIDN'T have ANY money' — inkor gapda 'any'.

pairs.right: d  and they had four children.
pairs.whyUz:
AND — QO'SHISH.
Uylanish va farzandlar — bir yo'nalishdagi
oila voqealari.
'marry sb' — predlogSIZ ('marry WITH' XATO).

pairs.left: 3  We were in the fishing boat
pairs.right: f  when it started to rain.
pairs.whyUz:
WHEN — VAQT.
Ikki voqea BIR VAQTDA sodir bo'lgan:
qayiqda edilar + yomg'ir boshlandi.
'start TO rain' yoki 'start RAINING' — ikkalasi
to'g'ri.

pairs.left: 4  I wanted to make a cake,
pairs.right: a  but I didn't have any sugar or flour.
pairs.rightUz: lekin menda shakar ham, un ham yo'q edi.
pairs.whyUz:
BUT — QARAMA-QARSHILIK.
Xohladi ↔ LEKIN masalliq yo'q edi.
'flour' = un.
DIQQAT: 'flour' va 'flower' (gul) BIR XIL
o'qiladi, lekin boshqa ma'no.

pairs.left: 5  First, they got into the canoe,
pairs.right: e  then they started paddling down the river.
pairs.rightUz: keyin daryo bo'ylab eshkak eshishni boshlashdi.
pairs.whyUz:
THEN — KETMA-KETLIK.
ENG OSON BAND: 'FIRST ...' so'zi 'THEN' ni
talab qiladi — bu TURG'UN juftlik.
'to paddle' = eshkak eshmoq.
'The Expedition' 1-epizodida ham kanoe bor edi.

pairs.left: 6  Roberta didn't like any of the souvenirs,
pairs.right: c  so she didn't buy any.
pairs.leftUz: Robertaga esdalik sovg'alarning hech biri yoqmadi,
pairs.rightUz: shuning uchun u hech narsa sotib olmadi.
pairs.whyUz:
SO — NATIJA.
Yoqmadi → SHUNING UCHUN sotib olmadi.
DIQQAT: ikki qismda ham 'ANY' —
har ikkisi INKOR gap.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with phrases from the list. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan to'ldiring. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ibora, 8 ta bo'shliq):
  lucky to be alive, I suppose, back then, though,
  who did, was fantastic, did you go, can you tell me


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BACK THEN
  2  I SUPPOSE
  3  LUCKY TO BE ALIVE
  4  THOUGH
  5  DID YOU GO
  6  CAN YOU TELL ME
  7  WHO DID
  8  WAS FANTASTIC


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR VA TARJIMASI:

  1  A: Grandad, what was it like when you were a
        boy?
     B: Oh, life was very difficult BACK THEN!
     (Bobojon, bola bo'lganingizda hayot qanday
      edi? — Oh, o'sha paytlarda hayot juda
      qiyin edi!)

  2  A: We can't afford this hotel. It's too
        expensive!
     B: Oh, I SUPPOSE you're right. Let's look for
        something cheaper.
     (Bu mehmonxonaga imkonimiz yetmaydi. U juda
      qimmat! — Ha, sen haqsan shekilli. Kel
      arzonrog'ini qidiraylik.)

  3  A: Lions are very dangerous animals. You're
        LUCKY TO BE ALIVE!
     B: Yes, I know. I was nearly a lion's lunch!
     (Sherlar juda xavfli hayvonlar. Tirik
      qolganingiz omadingiz! — Ha, bilaman. Sal
      bo'lmasa sherning tushligi bo'lardim!)

  4  A: My house is very old.
     B: Yes, it is. It's very beautiful, THOUGH.
     (Uyim juda eski. — Ha, shunday. Lekin u juda
      chiroyli.)

  5  A: Where DID YOU GO last weekend?
     B: I went to the art museum.
     (O'tgan dam olish kunlari qayerga bording? —
      San'at muzeyiga bordim.)

  6  A: Excuse me, CAN YOU TELL ME the way to the
        post office?
     B: Yes, of course. Go down this street and
        turn left.
     (Kechirasiz, pochtaga yo'lni ayta olasizmi? —
      Ha, albatta. Shu ko'cha bo'ylab yuring va
      chapga buriling.)

  7  A: WHO DID Mother go shopping with?
     B: She went with Aunt May.
     (Oyim kim bilan xaridga bordi? — U Mey
      xolam bilan bordi.)

  8  A: Did you enjoy your holiday?
     B: Yes, it WAS FANTASTIC!
     (Ta'tiling senga yoqdimi? — Ha, ajoyib edi!)


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'life was very difficult ......!'
     'when you were a boy' haqida gap →
     O'TMISh → 'BACK THEN' (o'sha paytlarda).

  2  'Oh, ...... you're right.'
     Rozilikni YUMShATADI → 'I SUPPOSE'
     (shekilli, menimcha).
     Coursebook 86-betdagi mehmonxona dialogida
     ham: 'I suppose you're right.'

  3  'You're ......!'
     Javob: 'I was NEARLY A LION'S LUNCH!' →
     o'lim yoqasidan qaytgan →
     'LUCKY TO BE ALIVE' (tirik qolgani omad).

  4  'It's very beautiful, ...... .'
     Vergul bilan ajratilgan va gap OXIRIDA →
     'THOUGH' (lekin).
     'though' gap oxirida QARAMA-QARShILIKNI
     bildiradi.

  5  'Where ...... last weekend?'
     Javob: 'I WENT to the art museum' →
     PAST SIMPLE savol → 'DID YOU GO'.

  6  'Excuse me, ...... the way to the post
     office?'
     Yo'l so'rash iborasi → 'CAN YOU TELL ME'.

  7  '...... Mother go shopping with?'
     Javob: 'She went WITH Aunt May' → ODAM →
     'WHO DID' + ega + asosiy fe'l.
     DIQQAT: 'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

  8  'Yes, it ......!'
     Ijobiy javob → 'WAS FANTASTIC'.
     Coursebook 85-betdagi 15-mashqda ham:
     'It was fantastic!'


DIQQAT — 7-BAND: TO'LDIRUVChI SAVOLI:
  'WHO DID Mother go shopping WITH?'
  'who' TO'LDIRUVChI o'rnida → 'DID' KERAK.
  Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) qoidasi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  back then      = o'sha paytlarda
  I suppose      = shekilli, menimcha
  lucky to be alive = tirik qolgani omad
  though         = lekin (gap oxirida)
  Can you tell me the way to ...? = ... ga yo'lni
                                    ayta olasizmi?
  to afford      = imkoni yetmoq
  an art museum  = san'at muzeyi

items.sentence: 1  A: Grandad, what was it like when you were a boy?  B: Oh, life was very difficult ............ !

commonMistake.whyUz:
'when you WERE a boy' → O'TMISH haqida gap.
'BACK THEN' = o'sha paytlarda.
O'tmishga ishora qiluvchi ibora.

items.sentence: 2  A: We can't afford this hotel.  B: Oh, ............ you're right.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'I SUPPOSE' = shekilli, menimcha.
Rozilikni YUMSHATADI (to'liq ishonch emas).
Coursebook 86-bet, 17-mashqda ham:
'Oh, I suppose you're right.'

items.sentence: 3  A: Lions are very dangerous animals. You're ............ !

commonMistake.whyUz:
Javob IPNI beradi: 'I was NEARLY A LION'S LUNCH!'
= sal bo'lmasa sher yeb qo'yardi.
→ 'LUCKY TO BE ALIVE' (tirik qolgani omad).
Grammar 52-bet: 'lucky to be alive'.

items.sentence: 4  A: My house is very old.  B: Yes, it is. It's very beautiful, ............ .

commonMistake.whyUz:
Vergul bilan ajratilgan va gap OXIRIDA →
'THOUGH' (lekin).
Eski, LEKIN chiroyli — qarama-qarshilik.
Coursebook 88-betdagi epizodda ham:
'David needs a new camera, THOUGH.'

items.sentence: 5  A: Where ............ last weekend?  B: I went to the art museum.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Javob 'I WENT ...' → PAST SIMPLE.
Savol: DID + you + GO (ASOSIY shakl).
'Where did you went' XATO.

items.sentence: 6  A: Excuse me, ............ the way to the post office?

commonMistake.whyUz:
Yo'l so'rash iborasi:
'CAN YOU TELL ME the way to ...?'
'Excuse me' bilan boshlanadi — muloyim murojaat.
Javob: 'Go down this street and turn left.'

items.sentence: 7  A: ............ Mother go shopping with?  B: She went with Aunt May.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Javob ODAM ('with Aunt May') →
TO'LDIRUVCHI savoli → 'WHO DID' + ega + asosiy
fe'l.
DIQQAT: 'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) qoidasi.

items.sentence: 8  A: Did you enjoy your holiday?  B: Yes, it ............ !

commonMistake.whyUz:
IJOBIY javob → 'WAS FANTASTIC'.
Coursebook 85-bet, 15-mashqda ham:
'It was fantastic!'
O'tgan zamon — ta'til tugagan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct words from the list, then ask and answer questions about Winston Churchill. (9 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri so'zlarni to'ldiring, so'ng Uinston Cherchill haqida savol berib, javob bering. (9 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta so'z, 9 ta bo'shliq):
  education, famous, born, helped, studied,
  loved, worked, married, died


TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Winston Churchill was a 1) FAMOUS British
  politician. He was 2) BORN in Oxfordshire,
  England, on 30th November, 1874.

  He 3) STUDIED at the Royal Military College in
  Sandhurst. After he completed his 4) EDUCATION
  in 1896, he became a journalist and 5) WORKED
  for a newspaper. Three years later he became a
  politician.

  He became Prime Minister in 1940. He was very
  popular. The people 6) LOVED him for his
  strength and wisdom. He 7) HELPED his country
  very much during the Second World War. He
  8) MARRIED Clementine Hozier in 1908.

  Churchill 9) DIED at home in 1965. He was 91
  years old.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Uinston Cherchill mashhur britaniyalik siyosatchi
  edi. U 1874-yil 30-noyabrda Angliyaning
  Oksfordshir grafligida tug'ilgan.

  U Sandxerstdagi Qirollik harbiy kollejida
  o'qigan. 1896-yilda ta'limini tugatgach,
  jurnalist bo'ldi va gazetada ishladi. Uch yildan
  keyin siyosatchi bo'ldi.

  U 1940-yilda Bosh vazir bo'ldi. U juda mashhur
  edi. Xalq uni kuchi va donoligi uchun sevardi.
  U Ikkinchi jahon urushi davrida o'z mamlakatiga
  juda katta yordam berdi. U 1908-yilda
  Klementina Xoziyerga uylangan.

  Cherchill 1965-yilda uyida vafot etdi. U 91
  yoshda edi.


HAR BIR JAVOB QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'was a ...... British politician'
     'a' + sifat + ot → SIFAT kerak → FAMOUS.

  2  'He was ...... in Oxfordshire ... on 30th
     November, 1874.'
     'be BORN' — tug'ilmoq (turg'un birikma).
     Sana va joy → BORN.

  3  'He ...... at the Royal Military College'
     Kollejda nima qiladi? → STUDIED (o'qidi).
     'study AT a college' — predlog AT.

  4  'After he completed his ...... in 1896'
     'complete one's EDUCATION' = ta'limini
     tugatmoq.
     'his' dan keyin OT kerak → EDUCATION.

  5  'he became a journalist and ...... for a
     newspaper'
     'work FOR a newspaper' = gazetada ishlamoq.
     → WORKED.

  6  'The people ...... him for his strength and
     wisdom.'
     Xalq uni nima qildi? → LOVED (sevdi).
     'love sb FOR sth' = kimnidir nimasi uchun
     sevmoq.

  7  'He ...... his country very much during the
     Second World War.'
     Mamlakatiga nima qildi? → HELPED (yordam
     berdi).

  8  'He ...... Clementine Hozier in 1908.'
     Ayol ismi → MARRIED (uylandi).
     'marry sb' — predlogSIZ.

  9  'Churchill ...... at home in 1965.'
     Oxirgi voqea → DIED (vafot etdi).


ESLATMA — KITOBDA KIChIK FAKTIK XATO:
  Matn Cherchillni 1965-yilda vafot etganda
  '91 years old' deydi.
  Aslida: tug'ilgan 30.11.1874, vafot etgan
  24.01.1965 → u 90 YOShDA edi.
  Bu mashq javoblariga ta'sir qilmaydi.


UINSTON ChERChILL HAQIDA:
  1874-1965. Britaniyaning Bosh vaziri
  (1940-1945 va 1951-1955).
  Ikkinchi jahon urushi davridagi rahbarligi
  bilan mashhur.
  Adabiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofoti sovrindori
  (1953).


HIKOYAT (BIOGRAFIYA) TUZILIShI:
  1) kim edi + tug'ilgan joy va sana
  2) ta'lim va birinchi ish
  3) asosiy yutuqlar va shaxsiy hayot
  4) vafoti
  Bu tuzilish 11-mashqda ham kerak bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a politician      = siyosatchi
  to be born        = tug'ilmoq
  a military college = harbiy kollej
  education         = ta'lim
  a journalist      = jurnalist
  Prime Minister    = Bosh vazir
  strength          = kuch
  wisdom            = donolik
  during            = ... davomida
  the Second World War = Ikkinchi jahon urushi

items.sentence: 1  Winston Churchill was a ............ British politician.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'a ...... British POLITICIAN' — 'a' va otning
orasida → SIFAT kerak.
Ro'yxatdagi yagona sifat — FAMOUS (mashhur).

items.sentence: 2  He was ............ in Oxfordshire, England, on 30th November, 1874.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'be BORN' = tug'ilmoq (turg'un birikma).
Joy va SANA berilgan → BORN.
DIQQAT: 'ON 30th November' — aniq sana → ON
(90-bet, 3-mashqning qoidasi).

items.sentence: 3  He ............ at the Royal Military College in Sandhurst.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Kollejda nima qiladi? → STUDIED (o'qidi).
'study AT a college' — muassasa bilan AT.
Sandxerst — Britaniyaning mashhur harbiy
akademiyasi.

items.sentence: 4  After he completed his ............ in 1896, he became a journalist.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'HIS ......' — egalik olmoshidan keyin OT kerak.
'complete one's EDUCATION' = ta'limini tugatmoq.
90-betdagi 1-mashqning 4-bandi ham shu ibora:
'Princess Diana COMPLETED HER EDUCATION.'

items.sentence: 5  ... he became a journalist and ............ for a newspaper.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'...... FOR a newspaper' → 'work FOR' turg'un
birikma (biror joyda ishlamoq).
→ WORKED.
'and' dan keyin ega takrorlanmaydi.

items.sentence: 6  The people ............ him for his strength and wisdom.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Xalq uni nima qildi? → LOVED (sevdi).
'love sb FOR sth' = kimnidir nimasi uchun sevmoq.
'strength' = kuch, 'wisdom' = donolik.

items.sentence: 7  He ............ his country very much during the Second World War.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Mamlakatiga nima qildi? → HELPED (yordam berdi).
'help sb' — predlogSIZ.
'during' = ... davomida.

AYOL ISMI berilgan → MARRIED (uylandi).
'marry sb' — predlogSIZ ('marry WITH' XATO).
DIQQAT: xatboshida tartib buzilgan —
uylanish (1908) Bosh vazirlikdan (1940) OLDIN
sodir bo'lgan.

items.sentence: 9  Churchill ............ at home in 1965. He was 91 years old.

commonMistake.whyUz:
Oxirgi voqea → DIED (vafot etdi).
'die AT home' — predlog AT.
'IN 1965' — faqat yil → IN.
ESLATMA: kitob '91 years old' deydi, aslida
u 90 yoshda edi (30.11.1874 - 24.01.1965).

exercises.instructionEn: Study the information below, then write a short biography of Bette Davis. (20 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ma'lumotni o'rganing, so'ng Bett Devis haqida qisqa tarjimai hol yozing. (20 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN MA'LUMOT KARTOChKASI:

  BETTE DAVIS
  famous film and theatre actress

  BORN:     Lowell, Massachusetts, in the USA /
            5th April, 1908
  STUDIED:  drama / New York
  1931:     go to Hollywood
  1935:     win / Oscar for Best Actress
  POPULAR:  because of her beauty and talent
  MARRIED:  Gary Marrill / 1950
  DIED:     1989 / Paris, France


TO'LIQ NAMUNA TARJIMAI HOL:

  BETTE DAVIS

  Bette Davis was a famous film and theatre
  actress. She was born in Lowell, Massachusetts,
  in the USA, on 5th April, 1908.

  She studied drama in New York. In 1931 she went
  to Hollywood and in 1935 she won an Oscar for
  Best Actress.

  She was very popular because of her beauty and
  talent. She married Gary Marrill in 1950.

  Bette Davis died in Paris, France, in 1989.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  BETT DEVIS

  Bett Devis mashhur kino va teatr aktrisasi edi.
  U 1908-yil 5-aprelda AQShning Massachusets
  shtatidagi Louell shahrida tug'ilgan.

  U Nyu-Yorkda dramaturgiyani o'rgangan.
  1931-yilda Gollivudga bordi va 1935-yilda
  'Eng yaxshi aktrisa' nominatsiyasida Oskar
  mukofotini qo'lga kiritdi.

  U go'zalligi va iste'dodi tufayli juda mashhur
  edi. U 1950-yilda Geri Merrilga turmushga
  chiqdi.

  Bett Devis 1989-yilda Fransiyaning Parij
  shahrida vafot etdi.


TUZILISh — 10-MAShQDAGI ChERChILL MATNI KABI:

  1-xatboshi:  kim edi + qayerda va qachon
               tug'ilgan
  2-xatboshi:  ta'lim + kariyera voqealari
               (yillar bilan)
  3-xatboshi:  nega mashhur + shaxsiy hayot
  4-xatboshi:  qachon va qayerda vafot etgan


KARTOChKADAN GAPGA — QANDAY AYLANTIRISh:

  'BORN: Lowell, Massachusetts / 5th April, 1908'
     → 'She WAS BORN IN Lowell, Massachusetts,
        ON 5th April, 1908.'
     JOY → IN,  ANIQ SANA → ON

  'STUDIED: drama / New York'
     → 'She STUDIED drama IN New York.'

  '1931: go to Hollywood'
     → 'IN 1931 she WENT to Hollywood.'
     go → WENT (o'tgan zamon!)

  '1935: win / Oscar for Best Actress'
     → 'IN 1935 she WON an Oscar FOR Best Actress.'
     win → WON (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  'POPULAR: because of her beauty and talent'
     → 'She WAS very popular BECAUSE OF her beauty
        and talent.'
     'because OF' + OT (gap emas!)

  'MARRIED: Gary Marrill / 1950'
     → 'She MARRIED Gary Marrill IN 1950.'
     'marry sb' — predlogSIZ

  'DIED: 1989 / Paris, France'
     → 'She DIED IN Paris, France, IN 1989.'


ENG MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1) HAMMA FE'L O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
     was, was born, studied, went, won, married,
     died
     Kartochkada 'go', 'win' asosiy shaklda
     berilgan — ularni O'TGAN shaklga aylantiring:
        go  → WENT
        win → WON

  2) SANA PREDLOGLARI:
     ANIQ SANA → ON  (on 5th April, 1908)
     FAQAT YIL → IN  (in 1931, in 1935, in 1950,
                      in 1989)
     JOY       → IN  (in New York, in Paris)

  3) 'BECAUSE OF' + OT:
     'because OF her beauty' ✓
     'because her beauty' ✗
     ('because' dan keyin GAP kerak bo'lardi)


BETT DEVIS HAQIDA:
  1908-1989. Amerikalik aktrisa, Gollivudning
  eng mashhur yulduzlaridan biri.
  Ikki marta 'Eng yaxshi aktrisa' Oskarini
  olgan (1935 va 1938).

  ESLATMA: kitobda eri 'Gary MARRILL' deb
  yozilgan; haqiqiy yozilishi 'Gary MERRILL'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an actress = aktrisa ('an actor' — aktyor)
  drama      = dramaturgiya, teatr san'ati
  to win (won) = yutmoq, qo'lga kiritmoq
  an Oscar   = Oskar mukofoti
  beauty     = go'zallik
  talent     = iste'dod
  because of = ... tufayli

structure.heading: 1-xatboshi — KIM EDI va TUG'ILGANI
structure.guideUz:
KARTOChKADAN:
  'famous film and theatre actress'
  'BORN: Lowell, Massachusetts, in the USA /
   5th April, 1908'

QOLIP (Cherchill matnidan):
  'X was a [sifat] [kasb]. She was born in [joy],
   on [sana].'

DIQQAT: JOY → IN, ANIQ SANA → ON.
structure.modelEn: Bette Davis was a famous film and theatre actress. She was born in Lowell, Massachusetts, in the USA, on 5th April, 1908.

structure.heading: 2-xatboshi — TA'LIM va KARIYERA
structure.guideUz:
KARTOChKADAN:
  'STUDIED: drama / New York'
  '1931: go to Hollywood'
  '1935: win / Oscar for Best Actress'

DIQQAT — FE'LLARNI O'TGAN ShAKLGA AYLANTIRING:
  go  → WENT
  win → WON
YILLAR bilan 'IN' ishlating.
structure.modelEn: She studied drama in New York. In 1931 she went to Hollywood and in 1935 she won an Oscar for Best Actress.

structure.heading: 3-xatboshi — MAShHURLIK va SHAXSIY HAYOT
structure.guideUz:
KARTOChKADAN:
  'POPULAR: because of her beauty and talent'
  'MARRIED: Gary Marrill / 1950'

DIQQAT: 'BECAUSE OF' dan keyin faqat OT keladi.
'marry sb' — predlogSIZ.
structure.modelEn: She was very popular because of her beauty and talent. She married Gary Marrill in 1950.

structure.heading: 4-xatboshi — VAFOTI
structure.guideUz:
KARTOChKADAN:
  'DIED: 1989 / Paris, France'

QOLIP (Cherchill matnidan):
  'X died in [joy] in [yil].'
JOY → IN, YIL → IN.
structure.modelEn: Bette Davis died in Paris, France, in 1989.

patterns.formula: A is [QIYOSIY] THAN B.  /  A is THE [ORTTIRMA] OF/IN ... .  /  A isn't AS [ODDIY sifat] AS B.
patterns.exampleEn: Jenny is more beautiful than Mary. This is the most luxurious hotel of all. She isn't as clever as Mary.
patterns.exampleUz: Jenni Meridan go'zalroq. Bu hammasidan hashamatli mehmonxona. U Meri chalik aqlli emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
'than' → qiyosiy, 'the ... of/in' → orttirma,
'as ... as' → oddiy shakl.
Unit 12 ning uch asosiy qolipi.

patterns.exampleEn: She screamed desperately. Did the footballers play well? They played very badly.
patterns.exampleUz: U jon-jahdi bilan qichqirdi. Futbolchilar yaxshi o'ynadimi? Ular juda yomon o'ynashdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Fe'lni RAVISH aniqlaydi, sifat EMAS.
good → WELL, bad → BADLY.

patterns.formula: He was born IN [joy] ON [sana]. He died IN [joy] IN [yil].
patterns.exampleEn: He was born in Oxfordshire, England, on 30th November, 1874. Churchill died at home in 1965.
patterns.exampleUz: U 1874-yil 30-noyabrda Angliyaning Oksfordshir grafligida tug'ilgan. Cherchill 1965-yilda uyida vafot etdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
JOY → IN, ANIQ SANA → ON, FAQAT YIL → IN.
Biografiyaning ochilish va yopilish qolipi.

patterns.formula: She was very popular BECAUSE OF + OT.
patterns.exampleEn: She was very popular because of her beauty and talent.
patterns.exampleUz: U go'zalligi va iste'dodi tufayli juda mashhur edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'because OF' dan keyin faqat OT keladi.
'because' dan keyin esa GAP (ega + fe'l).

patterns.formula: WHO DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l + ... WITH?
patterns.exampleEn: Who did Mother go shopping with? — She went with Aunt May.
patterns.exampleUz: Oyim kim bilan xaridga bordi? — U Mey xolam bilan bordi.
patterns.explanationUz:
TO'LDIRUVCHI savoli → 'did' KERAK.
'with' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
